en.text: As the seller said, Three cylinders were without a company sticker, one was like in the photo, the code on the cylinders is similar, connected to the burner, the gas works identically, at room temperature. Conclusion: to whom the company sticker is not critical, then you can take and use. The weight of the new cylinders is ~ 295g.
